fact: Agence Ecofin reports that the education ministry announced on 25 February 2026 the launch of digital registration of primary pupils, to build a digital register giving each pupil a single school identity from entry to primary school, with examination officers and data managers of the regional, prefectoral and communal education offices starting training on the platform.

Agence Ecofin reports the registration launched on 25 February 2026 is for pupils of primary school; the article describes a launch and staff training and gives no count of pupils or schools registered.
Agence Ecofin reports, quoting the ministry, that training on the pupil registration platform is coordinated by the ministry's direction générale des examens et contrôle scolaire.

Cambridge Education's study for the ministry (MEPUA) and UNICEF, from a field mission of 7 to 20 March 2021, finds that pupil lists, enrolment and re-enrolment are managed by hand and separately in each school, that pupils have no unique identifier, and that no system exists to manage enrolment or to follow pupils' schooling and assessments.
system: manual pupil lists kept by each school (no learner-record system)

fact: The same study states that, as found on its mission of March 2021, no system at all exists for managing pupils' enrolment, registration and the follow-up of their schooling and assessments; it gives no count of schools.
system: manual pupil lists kept by each school (no learner-record system)

fact: A roadmap for digitalising the ministry's administrative and teaching management was validated by MEPUA, ANIEN and UNICEF on 2 November 2021; it provides for a single integrated information and management system whose pupil module covers attendance and absence, class assessments, transfers and examination results, with a unique pupil number and an electronic file per pupil.
system: système d'information et de gestion unique et intégré (SIGE, planned)
